title: Tool Capability Manifest
description: The control document a tool ships with, written before the tool is exposed to a model and versioned with the code. Origen: M20.1 (the manifest), Ejercicio 20.1 (owner, risk_tier, auth, effects, timeouts, audit, idempotency all validated by a script), M20.2 (phase separation), M20.3 (typed errors). Criterion for use: knowledge/patterns/tool-capability.md.

name.description: Stable name, readable by models and humans alike.

version.description: The manifest is versioned with the code.

owner.description: Who answers when this tool causes an incident. A queue is not an owner.

risk_tier.$comment: Enum bound to schemas/autonomy-levels.yaml: the canonical L0-L4 ids plus the aliases the book itself uses for the same rungs (irreversible_high in 20.1 and 26.2; read/analysis/reversible_write in 20.4; high in 30.2 and 32.3). A private vocabulary such as `medium` makes the tier unenforceable and is refused here.

intent.description: What the capability is for, in business terms. An intent that restates the name says nothing.

disponibilidad.description: Donde y para que la capacidad esta disponible: el eje que el catalogo del 20.4 compara con el CONTEXTO y no con el sujeto. Un objeto vacio quiere decir «en todas partes», que tambien es una respuesta; lo que el catalogo no puede hacer es adivinarla, porque leerla con `.get` deja el eje inerte y sin recortar nada.

jurisdiccion.description: Jurisdicciones donde la llamada es legal, en ISO 3166-1 alfa-2.

estado_caso.description: Estados del caso en los que la capacidad cabe.

proposito.description: Propositos declarados que admiten la llamada. Un proposito fuera de esta lista es un uso distinto, no el mismo uso.

coste_eur.description: Lo que factura la llamada al sistema de origen (29.4), en euros. El catalogo del 20.4 lo compara con el presupuesto del contexto. Un cero es «gratis» y vale: el valor queda libre, la clave no.

identity_level.description: Nivel de identidad que la llamada exige del sujeto. El 20.4 lo usa como uno de sus seis ejes de seleccion: sin el, el catalogo no puede recortar por identidad y ese eje queda inerte.

preconditions.description: When the call is legal, evaluated against authoritative state and never against the argument the model wrote.

effects.description: What there is to compensate. `writes` may be empty for a read tool, but it is declared.

idempotency.description: What a retry does. The key is composed of business fields (subject + resource + reason + window): a key built from a timestamp or a UUID never collides, so it never deduplicates.

approval.description: Who signs. Mandatory at the irreversible tier, see the conditional at the end of this schema.

audit.description: What is provable afterwards, and what must not be written down.

data_class.description: Clase del dato que la herramienta toca. La lee el catalogo del 20.4 y el guardia del 37.2: sin ella, el sustituto degrada la clase en silencio, que es la averia que el apartado existe para cerrar.

rollback.description: A named compensating action that exists and has been tested. Declared as an object, so `rollback: manual` does not validate.

tool.description: Must resolve to a real capability with its own manifest.

allOf.$comment: A·H, L4: an irreversible or regulated action with none of HITL, maker-checker or step-up auth is not graduated autonomy. The manifest carries the human barrier or it does not validate.
